subject: The secret mistake I almost made with your healing
preview_text: One user's confession about what almost ruined their recovery - and the simple truth that changed everything.
body_paragraphs: I got an email from Sarah last week that stopped me cold. She wrote: "I was doing everything right. The no-contact streak, the journaling, the whole thing. And then I made one mistake that sent me spiraling back to day one."

Her mistake? She thought healing was about forgetting. She was using the app to erase memories, to become someone who never loved her ex. But that's not healing - that's just building a new prison. The real breakthrough came when she stopped trying to delete the past and started using the "Breakup Story" journal prompt. She wrote the whole messy truth - not to dwell, but to understand. She told me: "For the first time, I saw the relationship as a chapter, not my entire book."

That's why we built the guided journaling feature the way we did. It's not about positive affirmations or fake optimism. It's about honest excavation. The AI therapist guides you through specific prompts that help you unpack what happened without getting stuck in the pain. Sarah used it every night for a week, and her mood chart went from a chaotic scribble to a clear, upward line.

Open the app right now and tap "Journal." Start with "My Breakup Story" - not to hurt, but to heal. Just be honest for 5 minutes. I'll be checking the dashboard tonight, hoping to see your progress line start to climb. P.S. Sarah just sent me a photo of her hiking a trail she was always "too busy" to explore with her ex. The caption: "New book, better chapter."
